newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Oce interim dividend same at 0.90 guilder.
newsitem.headline: Oce interim dividend same at 0.90 guilder.

text.p: Dutch photocopier maker Oce-van der Grinten NV said on Wednesday it would pay an unchanged interim dividend of 0.90 guilders.
The interim payout can be taken in cash or shares. The stock dividend, with a maximum five percent discount to the cash dividend, will be fixed on October 31, the company said.
The interim will be payable from November 12.
Oce posted third quarter net profit of 38.9 million guilders versus 22.7 million in the same period of 1995 and said it expects that growth to continue in the fourth quarter.
